Create the cover illustration for an illustrated book of modern fairy tales, in a square format. Do not write a title or any other text on it.

Picture: The small farmyard at dawn, a wide view. In the middle of the gravel yard, the Rooster stands with his chest thrust out, crowing at the pale lemon sky, while the Cow stands beside him, calmly chewing. In the yellow house next door, a window has just flown open, and the Cuckoo sticks his head out, his feathers standing out in all directions, beak open to answer.

Characters in this picture (nobody else, unless the picture description mentions them):
- the Rooster: A sleek, swaggering rooster of ordinary size with jet-black plumage that shimmers beetle-green, a tall, jagged scarlet comb, long scarlet wattles, small white earlobes, fiery orange eyes, a sharp slate-grey beak, slate-grey legs and a fountain of curving green-black sickle feathers for a tail. He carries himself like the man of the yard, chest out and head high, with a phone in a black case tucked under one wing.
- the Cow: A gentle, sturdy Norwegian farm cow with a glossy reddish-brown coat, a broad white stripe along her back and down her tail, a white belly, white-speckled legs, a pink nose, big, calm brown eyes with long lashes and two short, pale, upward-curving horns. She wears a blue rope halter with a short lead rope, and chews her cud slowly, unimpressed by everything around her.
- the Cuckoo: A slim, sleek common cuckoo, smaller than the rooster, with a smooth ash-blue-grey head, back and wings, a white belly finely barred with thin dark stripes, a long, rounded dark-grey tail edged with little white spots, bright yellow rings around his round eyes, a short, slightly curved dark beak with a yellow base and small yellow feet. One tuft of feathers always sticks up at the back of his head.

Story world: Present-day rural Norway. The Rooster, the Cuckoo and the Black Grouse are ordinary-sized birds who live like neighbours around the same small farmyard: three old wooden houses, one red, one yellow and one white, around a gravel yard with a barn, a flagpole and a few round, white-wrapped silage bales. They have phones, a group chat and one cow between them, bought on a Saturday from a seller in the car park of a shopping centre: a flat grey tarmac lot with painted parking bays, trolleys and rows of cars in front of a big, windowless shopping centre. The birds and the cow wear no clothes.

This story's season, light and colours: A Saturday in May under a flat, white overcast sky over grey tarmac; then twelve minutes past four the next morning: a pale lemon-and-lilac sky before sunrise, cool blue shadows in the farmyard, dew on the gravel and the first windows lighting up. Accents: the Rooster's scarlet comb, the Cow's russet coat and her blue rope halter.

The magic of the tale appears plainly in this everyday world: trolls, talking animals and enchantments look real and slightly absurd, drawn in the same flat style. Every character has their own face, build, age, hair and clothes exactly as described, so no two characters look alike. characters.name: Gjøken
characters.description: Lettantennelig og opportunistisk, som svarer umiddelbart og prøver å sikre seg i det minste en «halv ku».
characters.look: A slim, sleek common cuckoo, smaller than the rooster, with a smooth ash-blue-grey head, back and wings, a white belly finely barred with thin dark stripes, a long, rounded dark-grey tail edged with little white spots, bright yellow rings around his round eyes, a short, slightly curved dark beak with a yellow base and small yellow feet. characters.name: Århanen
characters.description: Den mest sindige av dem, som prøver å megle med fornuft og rettferdighet, mobil i hånda som om han vurderer å lese opp en avtale.
characters.look: A large, calm black grouse cock, a little bigger than the rooster, with glossy blue-black plumage, a bright-red fleshy arch like an eyebrow above each eye, a white bar across each wing, a fluffy snow-white puff under his tail and a lyre-shaped tail whose outer feathers curl outwards like hooks. He has feathered grey legs, a short black beak and wise dark eyes, stands tall like a judge, and always holds a phone in a green case in one wing.

characters.description: Kua som Hanen, Gjøken og Århanen kjøper sammen på parkeringsplassen ved kjøpesenteret. Hun står rolig med et tau om halsen og bryr seg lite om hvem som eier henne.

illustrations.caption: Hanen betalte med mobilen. Århanen sa ingenting.
illustrations.alt: På parkeringsplassen ved kjøpesenteret står ei ku med et tau om halsen mellom to stasjonsvogner. Hanen betaler med mobilen, Gjøken lener seg inn mot kvitteringen, og Århanen ser på kua.
